claim: Meta's Q2 2026 operating income dropped 8% from a year earlier.
summary: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, which is before the end of Meta's Q2 2026 (June 30, 2026) and its typical late-July earnings report. No verified operating income data for Q2 2026 is available within the cutoff, so the claimed 8% year-over-year drop cannot be corroborated or refuted.

sub_claims.text: Meta reported operating income for Q2 2026
sub_claims.note: Q2 2026 ends 2026-06-30, after knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04; no evidence available to confirm reporting of this period

sub_claims.text: Meta's Q2 2026 operating income was 8% lower than Q2 2025 operating income
sub_claims.note: No evidence available within knowledge window to verify year-over-year percentage change for operating income in Q2 2026
